value.rationale: This is a complete physically motivated classification of stationary phase profiles in the minimal noisy-reset synchronization model. The distinct reset-to-coupling and reset-to-relaxation thresholds and the explicit essential saddle-node edge supply precise observables for distinguishing phase locking, apparent density modes and endpoint accumulation, including exact equality boundaries. The finite two-body case is not an arbitrary parameter slice of the thermodynamic Lorentzian problem; the sharp geometry is relevant to phase-density measurements and parameter discrimination.
